title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "Eliza"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/atus.duckdb")

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  cross_join(dbplyr_codes |> distinct(major_name)) |>
  left_join(
    dbplyr_act |>
      inner_join(
        dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
        by = "activity_code"
      ) |>
      group_by(tucaseid, major_name) |>
      summarize(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = c("tucaseid", "major_name"),
    copy = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(minutes = coalesce(minutes, 0)) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(activity_avg = mean(minutes)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| include: false
weekday_resp <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  select(tucaseid, sex)

selected_codes <- dbplyr_codes |>
  filter(major_code %in% c(1, 2, 3, 12)) |>
  select(activity_code, major_name)

hourly_totals <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = floor(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  filter(hour >= 6, hour <= 23) |>
  inner_join(weekday_resp, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(selected_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarize(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  collect()

respondent_counts <- weekday_resp |>
  count(sex, name = "n_respondents") |>
  collect()

selected_categories <- selected_codes |>
  distinct(major_name) |>
  collect()

hourly_avg <- crossing(
  sex = respondent_counts$sex,
  major_name = selected_categories$major_name,
  hour = 6:23
) |>
  left_join(hourly_totals, by = c("sex", "major_name", "hour")) |>
  left_join(respondent_counts, by = "sex") |>
  mutate(
    minutes = coalesce(minutes, 0),
    hourly_avg = minutes / n_respondents
  ) |>
  select(sex, major_name, hour, hourly_avg) |>
  arrange(sex, major_name, hour)

```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(major_name, activity_avg),
    y = activity_avg,
    fill = sex
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Time by Major Activity Category",
    subtitle = "Weekday respondents not in the labor force, by sex",
    x = "Major activity category",
    y = "Average minutes per day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey data in data/atus.duckdb"
  )
```

```{r}
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = hourly_avg, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(6, 22, by = 2),
    labels = \(hour) sprintf("%02d:00", hour)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How Weekday Activity Fills the Day",
    subtitle = "Average minutes starting each hour for respondents not in the labor force",
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Major activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey data in data/atus.duckdb"
  )
```
